name: Develop a family of large action models specifically

representative_ideas: Develop a family of large action models specifically designed to enhance AI agent capabilities across diverse tasks
common_problems: Existing language models lack specialized action-taking capabilities required for autonomous agent systems
solution_approaches: Develop xLAM family of large action models trained to empower AI agent systems with enhanced action execution capabilities
story: Introduce a new paradigm of action-oriented language models that bridge the gap between language understanding and autonomous action execution in agentic systems
application: AI agent systems, autonomous task execution, interactive AI assistants

title: xLAM: A Family of Large Action Models to Empower AI Agent Systems

name: Ground LLM personality formation in large-scale human dialogue

representative_ideas: Ground LLM personality formation in large-scale human dialogue data rather than prompt engineering, using supervised fine-tuning and preference optimization to achieve more realistic and psychologically valid personality expressions
common_problems: Prompt-based methods for embedding personality traits in LLMs suffer from realism and validity issues, lacking grounding in how humans actually express personality in natural language
solution_approaches: Construct BIG5-CHAT dataset with 100,000 human dialogues expressing personality traits, then apply Supervised Fine-Tuning and Direct Preference Optimization to train LLMs on this human-grounded data, achieving trait correlations that better match human personality distributions
story: Reframe LLM personality from a superficial prompting trick into a trainable, grounded capability by demonstrating that training on authentic human behavioral data produces more psychologically valid and realistic personalities; connect to psychological research showing personality traits impact cognitive performance, elevating the work from engineering to interdisciplinary research
application: Personalized AI assistants with consistent personality profiles, therapeutic chatbots with empathetic personality traits, customer service agents tailored to brand personality, educational tutors with adaptive personality types

title: BIG5-CHAT: Shaping LLM Personalities Through Training on Human-Grounded Data

name: Expose and measure implicit demographic biases in LLM

representative_ideas: Expose and measure implicit demographic biases in LLM responses using semantic shift analysis and preference win rates across power-imbalanced social scenarios
common_problems: LLMs exhibit implicit demographic biases including a 'default persona' bias toward specific demographics, with degraded response quality for certain groups especially under power-imbalanced conditions
solution_approaches: Propose cosine distance-based semantic shift measurement and LLM-judged Preference Win Rate to evaluate how demographic prompts affect response quality across power-disparate scenarios
story: Reframe LLM bias from a model training issue into a systemic auditing problem, exposing the 'default persona' phenomenon and revealing how power disparities amplify implicit biases
application: LLM bias auditing, fairness evaluation frameworks, bias mitigation pipeline development

title: Unmasking Implicit Bias: Evaluating Persona-Prompted LLM Responses in Power-Disparate Social Scenarios

name: Introduce dynamic action re-sampling at key decision points

representative_ideas: Introduce dynamic action re-sampling at key decision points during agent execution to enable adaptive tree traversal and efficient recovery from suboptimal decisions in coding agents
common_problems: Existing coding agents suffer from suboptimal decision-making that requires either extensive manual intervention or inefficient compute scaling through random sampling, leading to wasted resources and poor performance on complex development tasks
solution_approaches: Develop Dynamic Action Re-Sampling (DARS), an inference-time compute scaling approach that branches trajectories at key decision points by taking alternative actions given execution history and feedback, enabling adaptive tree traversal that efficiently recovers from suboptimal paths
story: Reframe coding agent performance from a static execution problem into an adaptive exploration problem; position DARS as a principled approach to inference-time scaling that intelligently allocates compute by identifying and branching from decision forks rather than relying on random exploration, achieving SOTA results with faster and more effective recovery from failures
application: Automated code generation and refactoring, intelligent debugging assistants, autonomous software development agents, code review and optimization tools, complex multi-file software engineering tasks

title: DARS: Dynamic Action Re-Sampling to Enhance Coding Agent Performance by Adaptive Tree Traversal

name: Improve language model spatial reasoning by training with

representative_ideas: Improve language model spatial reasoning by training with neuro-symbolic constraints that encode spatial logical rules as additional supervision
common_problems: State-of-the-art language models struggle with spatial reasoning over text, particularly nested spatial expressions, due to failure to achieve proper abstraction for generalizability
solution_approaches: Train language models with neuro-symbolic techniques that incorporate spatial logical rules as constraints, providing additional supervision to guide models toward effective abstractions for spatial knowledge transfer
story: Elevate spatial reasoning from a benchmark evaluation task to a fundamental abstraction and generalization problem, using logical constraints to bridge neural learning with symbolic reasoning for robust transfer across domains
application: Human-robot interaction, navigation systems, spatial question answering, embodied AI

title: Neuro-symbolic Training for Reasoning over Spatial Language

name: Build a comprehensive framework for detecting LLM-generated code

representative_ideas: Build a comprehensive framework for detecting LLM-generated code across diverse programming languages, generators, and domains with strong generalization
common_problems: Existing LLM-generated code detection methods lack domain coverage, robustness, and multi-language support, covering only limited programming languages and failing on out-of-domain scenarios
solution_approaches: Develop a unified framework using large-scale datasets from diverse platforms, feature engineering, and comparative analysis of traditional ML, PLMs, and LLMs for cross-lingual, cross-generator, and cross-domain detection
story: Position code detection as a critical infrastructure for maintaining programming integrity and assessment standards in the LLM era, framing the problem as a comprehensive robustness challenge across multiple dimensions
application: Academic integrity assessment, code authorship verification, plagiarism detection, AI-assisted programming oversight

title: CoDet-M4: Detecting Machine-Generated Code in Multi-Lingual, Multi-Generator and Multi-Domain Settings

name: Analyze and quantify the reliability of topic modeling

representative_ideas: Analyze and quantify the reliability of topic modeling outputs to understand consistency and stability of discovered topics
common_problems: Topic modeling outputs may be unreliable or unstable across different runs, parameter settings, or data subsets, making interpretation and downstream usage risky
solution_approaches: Develop methodology to quantify reliability of topic models by measuring consistency, stability, and sensitivity to perturbations
story: Shift focus from topic model accuracy to trustworthiness and reliability, framing model evaluation through a lens of reproducibility and robustness
application: Academic literature analysis, document summarization, information retrieval, trend analysis

title: Reliability of Topic Modeling

name: Improve NLP robustness against greenwashing by explicitly linking

representative_ideas: Improve NLP robustness against greenwashing by explicitly linking sustainability aspects with verifiable actions rather than relying on vague rhetorical claims
common_problems: NLP methods for ESG analysis lack robustness against greenwashing, extracting misleading or exaggerated sustainability claims instead of objective performance indicators
solution_approaches: Introduce A3CG dataset with aspect-action analysis that explicitly links sustainability aspects to verifiable actions, enabling fine-grained evaluation grounded in concrete behaviors rather than vague rhetoric, with cross-category generalization to handle selective reporting
story: Reframe ESG analysis from a standard information extraction task into a robustness challenge against adversarial greenwashing, positioning aspect-action linking as a transparency mechanism that forces models to ground claims in verifiable actions
application: Corporate sustainability auditing, investment risk assessment, regulatory compliance screening for ESG claims

title: Towards Robust ESG Analysis Against Greenwashing Risks: Aspect-Action Analysis with Cross-Category Generalization

name: Develop a lightweight on-device language model specialized for

representative_ideas: Develop a lightweight on-device language model specialized for software API function calling to enable efficient, privacy-preserving tool use
common_problems: Existing language models for function calling require cloud deployment, raising privacy concerns and latency issues for real-time API interactions
solution_approaches: Design and deploy a specialized on-device language model optimized for software API function calling, enabling efficient local inference while maintaining accuracy
story: Frame on-device function calling as essential for privacy-preserving AI assistant deployment, positioning specialized lightweight models as the key enabler for secure, real-time tool use
application: Mobile AI assistants, privacy-sensitive enterprise applications, IoT device control, local workflow automation

title: Octopus: On-device language model for function calling of software APIs

name: Leverage chain-of-thought reasoning and human-in-the-loop feedback to enable

representative_ideas: Leverage chain-of-thought reasoning and human-in-the-loop feedback to enable LLMs to score and explain open-ended science assessments
common_problems: Existing LLM-based scoring methods cannot handle open-ended science assessments nor provide meaningful explanations for their evaluations
solution_approaches: Combine GPT-4 with few-shot learning, active learning, and chain-of-thought reasoning in a human-in-the-loop framework to score and explain middle school Earth Science responses
story: Transform automated grading from mere scoring into an interactive feedback generation system, reframing LLMs as collaborative assessment partners that can provide formative feedback to enhance learning
application: K-12 science education assessment, automated grading systems for open-ended responses, teacher assistance tools

title: A Chain-of-Thought Prompting Approach with LLMs for Evaluating Students’ Formative Assessment Responses in Science

name: Review and analyze current memory management approaches in

representative_ideas: Review and analyze current memory management approaches in LLM agents, identifying gaps in long-term memory implementation and proposing future research directions
common_problems: LLM agents lack effective long-term memory mechanisms; current vector database implementations fail to separate memory types and manage memory over agent lifetime
solution_approaches: Survey existing memory approaches in LLM agents, analyze vector database usage for storage/retrieval, identify open problems in memory separation and lifetime management
story: Position memory as the foundational bottleneck preventing LLM agents from achieving true autonomy and scalability, framing memory improvement as essential to agent evolution
application: Autonomous agent systems, persistent assistants, long-horizon task execution

title: Memory Matters: The Need to Improve Long-Term Memory in LLM-Agents

name: Extend beam search with conformal prediction to provide

representative_ideas: Extend beam search with conformal prediction to provide theoretical coverage guarantees for generated sequence sets
common_problems: Beam search produces sequences without principled uncertainty quantification, lacking coverage guarantees for generated outputs
solution_approaches: Propose two conformal prediction extensions: dynamically-sized beam subsets with calibration-dependent bounds, and adaptive beam width with a priori coverage guarantees
story: Bridge the gap between heuristic decoding methods and principled statistical guarantees, transforming beam search from a best-effort search into a calibrated set predictor with formal coverage guarantees
application: NLP text generation, chemistry molecule generation, any autoregressive sequence generation requiring uncertainty estimation

title: Conformal Autoregressive Generation: Beam Search with Coverage Guarantees
